source: Notion API reference (2026-03-11): page, data source and property objects, page property values, the data source query filter; refusals and the simulator-free choices are Fabric's own, named in each module

cases.name: a page's title is its title property, every piece joined
a data source's title is its own title, its title property being a schema
a piece without plain_text gives its text content
an object with no title is untitled
a piece that is not an object refuses
describe lists each property by name with what Fabric may write, read-only and unsupported ones with their reason
a select with no options yet is not writable: Fabric never creates an option
schema binds each writable property by name, with the select's options as its enum
a plain page binds only its title
plain values become typed values keyed by property id
a title of 4,500 characters becomes three pieces
an empty title clears it: no pieces
an unknown option refuses before any typed value is made
a name the data source does not have refuses
one condition per property, naming its id: contains for text and list items, equals for the rest
a where with no condition refuses: leave it out to read every row
plain values: each property's text and its one-line form, sorted by name
